Customer Statements (Transactions)

The Customer Statements Transactions form is used to configure report parameters.

Select customers and date ranges to generate transaction-based statements.

From

Enter the start date for the statement period.

To

Select the end date type. Today uses the current date, while Custom lets you specify a date.

ToCustomDate

Enter the specific end date when using Custom date type.

Theme

Select a theme to customize the appearance of printed statements.
